title: How a small private company quietly launched its way to 96 trips to space
title_candidates: The private rocket company that just hit 96 launches, and few people noticed
Rocket Lab's small rocket has quietly reached space 96 times
96 launches in, and Rocket Lab keeps sending satellites up like clockwork
How a small private company quietly launched its way to 96 trips to space
What Rocket Lab's Electron looks like at its 96th liftoff
caption:
96 launches. While the world watches the big rockets, Rocket Lab just passed a milestone that very few private space companies ever reach.

Electron is a small rocket, about the height of a five-story building, built to carry small satellites to exact orbits faster and cheaper than the bigger vehicles can. Rocket Lab runs a launch site in New Zealand and has been flying with increasing speed since 2018.

At 96, they are one of the most active private launch companies on the planet. Most people just haven't noticed.
